turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Think about what you did yesterday. Did you open a door or cook something? You can say that with the past.
Here is one worked example: "Today I jump. Yesterday I jumped." The action is finished, so I added -ed.
The rule is: add -ed to a regular verb for a finished action.
Right: They opened the window. Wrong: They open the window yesterday.
Now you try. Write the missing word: "Yesterday we ___ (cook) rice."
